notes: All values come from Volvo Group official annual-report eleven-year tables; SEK million balance sheet/income rows and SEK billion cash flows are scaled to full SEK. Cash flows retain the published one-decimal-billion precision. The eleven-year tables state that each historical year follows the accounting standards then applicable and is not restated for later accounting changes.

netIncome is attributable to owners of AB Volvo. totalEquity is left null where the extracted eleven-year table reports only total equity including non-controlling interests; subtraction was not used. FY2024–2025 uses directly published parent equity from the consolidated balance sheet.
capex is the consolidated cash-flow line Investments in fixed assets / Investments in in-/tangible assets, negative; purchases of assets for operating leases are separately reported and excluded.

sharesOutstanding is the published average number of shares outstanding in millions, scaled to shares, rather than a computed sum of A/B closing share classes. dividendPerShare is the ordinary dividend associated with the fiscal year; extraordinary distributions are separately reported and excluded. A dash for FY2019 dividend is retained as null, not assumed zero.

employees is regular employees at year-end excluding consultants/temporary staff from FY2009; FY2007–2008 include temporary employees. IFRS16 lease changes and divestments change comparability. Diluted EPS is left null where only basic EPS is published in the extracted multiyear tables.
